world_order: ascending world id, one line per world
serialization: explicit f-string rows (x,y,t,kappa,phi,z,m,a_cmd,a_realized,reward:.6f) joined by '|', then ':' then the feedback bits; Python hash() is never used
why_not_content_digest: support.content_digest hashes only _DENSE_FIELDS (kappa, phase, error_flag, cause_rank, proposal, Z_code, p0..p4, block_id, fire_code) -- integer partition fields. The observable payload is not hashed, so a payload change that leaves the partition intact could pass it unchanged
obligation: after the kernel patch this script must reproduce observable_digest EXACTLY; a mismatch means the patch changed a closed version's world regardless of the support digest
